# Hearing Consultants of Colorado Springs

> A trusted Colorado Springs audiology practice offering comprehensive hearing care, advanced hearing aids, tinnitus treatment, and personalized audiological services from experienced doctors of audiology.

Hearing Consultants of Colorado Springs is a patient-centered audiology clinic specializing in hearing assessments, hearing aid fitting and repair, tinnitus treatment including FDA-approved Lenire therapy, and custom hearing protection. The practice is led by experienced Au.D. professionals including owner Cassie Iliff and her team of certified audiologists serving the Colorado Springs and Southern Colorado region.

## Key Topics

- Hearing Consultants of Colorado Springs
- Au.D. (Doctor of Audiology)
- CCC-A (Certificate of Clinical Competence in Audiology)

## Core Services

- [Hearing Tests & Assessments](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/comprehensive-hearing-assessments): Comprehensive hearing evaluations and testing services in Colorado Springs.
- [Advanced Hearing Aids](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/advanced-hearing-aid-technology): Advanced hearing aid technology and solutions in Colorado Springs.
- [Tinnitus Treatment Experts](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/tinnitus-treatment): Tinnitus treatment and relief services in Colorado Springs.
- [Lenire Tinnitus Treatment](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/lenire): FDA-approved Lenire tinnitus treatment in Colorado Springs.
- [Hearing Aid Repair Services](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/hearing-aid-repairs): Professional hearing aid repair and maintenance services.
- [Custom Hearing Protection](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/hearing-protection): Custom hearing protection for musicians and workers.
- [Professional Earwax Removal](https://myhearingconsultants.com/services/earwax-removal): Professional earwax removal services in Colorado Springs.
